tasks.spec: Start from exact accepted MVP-BASE-001 SHA 25f00004f83185be3d987424b28f627f3854b35d after MVP-QA-002 is accepted. Do not merge or cherry-pick rejected Experience candidate 70338ef07670b4e62eb0b6633c76beb6997ee0f3; it may be read only as a failed design reference. Recreate its independently validated Style A layout, Chinese copy, action sequence, responsive code, tests, and card depth without failed commit ancestry. Fix exactly two integration blockers. First, the production FixtureExperience entry must default to a fixed typed HTTP ExperienceClient that consumes the accepted MVP-QA-002 state and command seam. The client must use the accepted fixed Fixture endpoints and exact accepted request and response shapes, must never place role, actor, space, scenario, content, private text, or guessed identifiers in ordinary command bodies, and must fail closed on non-2xx or malformed responses. Keep any in-memory client only as an explicitly injected test dependency; do not use it as the production default and do not add a 404 fallback. Second, add apps/web/src/app/(ui)/fixtures/mvp-core/page.tsx and make both / and /fixtures/mvp-core render the same shared FixtureExperience component. Do not create API routes, server state, authentication, backend adapters, or a parallel wire contract in this lane. Preserve the exact Style A colors, system fonts, 18px by 16px core-card padding, compact rail, three phone-proportioned desktop surfaces, one active mobile surface, vertical title/body-or-evidence/state/action zones, exact 补齐上次检查结果 copy, truth labels, and core journey. Verification remains code-only: no browser or container UI operation in this task.
